caseNameFull: John Nuveen & Co., Inc. v. Sanders

opinions.text:
C. A. 7th Cir. Motions of Securities Industry Assn, and Lehman Commercial Paper, Inc., for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Ernst & Ernst v. Hochfelder, ante, p. 185.

Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the con*930sideration or decision of this case.
